user_story: As a user, I want to log into the application using my credentials so that I can access the secure area. Acceptance criteria: 1. When I enter 'tomsmith' in the input field with id 'username' and 'SuperSecretPassword!' in the input field with id 'password', and click the button with text 'Login', I should be redirected to the secure area. 2. If I leave the input fields empty and click the button with text 'Login', I should remain on the page with the URL 'https://the-internet.herokuapp.com/login'.
